'''Ketwol''' was a [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Prospector/Legends|prospector]], [[Scout/Legends|scout]], and enemy of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. He traveled the galaxy in the ''[[Herd Mother]]'', his [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. He sold the precious [[Ore/Legends|ores]] and [[Metal/Legends|metals]] he mined from [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] like [[Tatooine]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In his downtime, he gathered information he needed to locate new planets in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], one of which was [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on Tatooine. By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he took care of a group of [[Jerba/Legends|jerbas]] that had previously belonged to the woman [[Swilla Corey]].

In 0 BBY, he visited the Tatooine cantina and talked with the [[Lamproid/Legends|Lamproid]] [[Dice Ibegon/Legends|Dice Ibegon]] and met with the patrons [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]] and [[Arleil Schous/Legends|Arleil Schous]] over [[Merenzane Gold/Legends|Merenzane Gold]]. After he left the cantina and made his way back to his starship, Corey tried to take her jerbas back from him but was caught. She explained her situation to him, and he let her stay with him for a [[Time/Legends|time]]. Corey eventually left with her jerbas and he allowed her to come back to him.

==Biography==
===Prospector and scout===
[[File:MEC.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Ketwol spent his downtime in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina (pictured).]]
Ketwol was a [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="DB" /> [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Prospector/Legends|prospector]] and part-time [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from an<ref name="POTJ" /> unknown<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Ketwol}}</ref> [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="POTJ" /> He traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] his old, poorly maintained [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Herd Mother]]''. Occasionally, Ketwol chartered passengers aboard the ''Herd Mother'' to make extra [[Currency/Legends|money]].<ref name="Sourcebook" /> He often sold precious [[Ore/Legends|ores]] and [[Metal/Legends|metals]] that he mined from asteroids in seedy [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and seamy tap cafés on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] like [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Sourcebook">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> The prosector was an enemy of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], sometimes mining asteroids in Imperial space. Ketwol also secretly supplied the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] with materials and information.<ref name="POTJ" /> 

In much of his downtime, he talked to spacers and travelers in cantinas, one of which being [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|214|Ketwol}}</ref> in the Tatooine [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="Mos Eisley">{{DB|location|moseisley|Mos Eisley}}</ref> Though the talks, the scout gathered information he needed to locate new planets.<ref name="CSWE" /> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="DBdate">The events of [[Swilla Corey]]'s [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry mentions events shown in {{Film|IV}}, which the ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Therefore, the events in the Databank entry must take place in 0 BBY.</ref> Ketwol took care of a group of [[Jerba/Legends|jerbas]], some wounded and exhausted, that had come from the Tatooine desert to his ship. The jerba group originally belonged to the woman [[Swilla Corey]], though she had lost them after a giant sandwhirl and an [[Anooba/Legends|anooba]] attack. Also, by that time, the ''Herd Mother'' was grounded in Mos Eisley and turned into a temporary home.<ref name="SwillaCorey">{{DB|character|swillacorey|Corey, Swilla}}</ref>

===Meeting Swilla Corey===
[[File:Ibegon-Labria-Ketwol-ANH.png|thumb|left|300px|Ketwol sat with Dice Ibegon.]]
In 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IV}} to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Ketwol, and one his jerbas,<ref name="SwillaCorey" /> visited Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> He sat in a booth<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and talked with the the [[Lamproid/Legends|Lamproid]] rebel [[Dice Ibegon/Legends|Dice Ibegon]],<ref name="TLC">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|pack=#37: Trinto Duaba & Dice Ibegon|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLC37trintodice.asp}}</ref> whom the Pacithhip managed to raise the ire of.<ref name="DB" /> At that booth, he met with the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]]<ref name="CL" /> [[Arleil Schous/Legends|Arleil Schous]]<ref name="Schous">{{CCG|set=Official Tournament Sealed Deck|cardname=Arleil Schous}}</ref> and the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]]<ref name="CL" /> [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]]<ref name="EGC" /> over a jigger of [[Merenzane Gold/Legends|Merenzane Gold]].<ref name="CL" /> Corey also was visiting at this time and recognized the brand on the jerba standing outside the cantina. One of Corey's friends, [[Kitik Keed'kak]], informed her that the jerba belonged to Ketwol. As that happened,<ref name="SwillaCorey" /> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was visiting the cantina in search of passage to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], protected his companion, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], from the thugs<ref name="ANH" /> [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] and [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]].<ref name="EGC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> After the altercation, Corey left and waited outside the cantina for Ketwol.<ref name="DB" />

Corey followed Ketwol to his grounded ship and seized the opportunity to steal back her jerba when the Pacithhip had his back turned. After he caught the woman, Ketwol explained to her how they had come to him and that he cared for them. Corey explained her unfortunate situation, and he understood her and offered her shelter. Corey spent some [[Time/Legends|time]] with Ketwol before she ventured out into the Tatooine desert with the jerbas. He allowed her to come back any time his ship was in Mos Eisley.<ref name="SwillaCorey" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:SwillaCorey1.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Swilla Corey (pictured) enjoyed Ketwol's company.]]
The hardworking<ref name="DB" /> and enigmatic<ref name="POTJ" /> Ketwol was an aloof but pleasant individual who kept to himself.<ref name="DB" /> Few tested his good nature.<ref name="Sourcebook" /> He was friends with Swilla Corey, and she enjoyed his company. Ketwol offered her shelter and allowed her to come back to him any time he was in Mos Eisley.<ref name="SwillaCorey" /> Ketwol had [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin, blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]<ref name="POTJ" /> and the short and round<ref name="CSWE" /> Pacithhip stood between 1.63 to 1.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], depending on his stilts.<ref name="DB" /> His sharp tusks could inflict damage and his thick hide could protect him from [[Stun/Legends|stun weapons]].<ref name="POTJ" />

==Skills and abilities==
Ketwol was deadly-accurate with his [[Protector PRP-500 Hold-Out Dart Pistol]]. Even without weapons, he was still considered dangerous, enough have made a living as a professional fighter. He lacked mechanical skills and, as a result, the ''Herd Mother'' often underwent repairs on Tatooine. Ketwol possessed average strength, slightly below average speed, and slightly above average endurance and intelligence.<ref name="POTJ" />

==Equipment==
Ketwol moved with a pair of mechanical stilts<ref name="DB" /> to both overcome his short round appearance,<ref name="CSWE" /> and to look more [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]].<ref name="DB" /> These stilts allowed him to operate machinery and use vehicles created for taller [[Alien/Legends|aliens]].<ref name="POTJ" /> He traveled in the ''Herd Mother'', an old and poorly maintained starship.<ref name="Sourcebook" /> He was aided by a<ref name="POTJ" /> [[LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer/Legends|LIN demolitiontech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

Ketwol used a Protector PRP-500 Hold-Out Dart Pistol which contained six darts full of concentrated [[symoxin]].<ref name="POTJ" /> He kept this pistol hidden away in his [[Clothing/Legends|tunic]].<ref name="Sourcebook" /> Other gear used by Ketwol included a [[Jawa ionization blaster/Legends|Jawa ionization blaster]] he got from a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] trader in exchange for a valuable but small amount of unrefined ore, and a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]] Ketwol claimed after finding taped to the bottom of a table in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina. He suspected that the dagger had been left there by an assassin.<ref name="POTJ" /> While in Mos Eisley in 0 BBY,<ref name="ANH" /> Ketwol wore a light-colored<ref name="POTJ" /> tunic,<ref name="Sourcebook" /> gray pants, black shoes on his stilts, and a red [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]].<ref name="POTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ketwol24.jpg|thumb|Ketwol employed robotic stilts to increase his height.]]

Ketwol was added to the 1997 [[List of changes in Star Wars re-releases|Special Edition]] re-release of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] to replace [[Lak Sivrak/Legends|Lak Sivrak]]. The Ketwol puppet was reversed and used for the character of [[Melas/Legends|Melas]] as well. Ketwol and Melas were both played by special effect artist [[Howie Weed]].
